Name: Fleeting Sunshine Project - Harumasa Asaba Custom Character
Author: Cerezaaaa
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[code]🌻🌻🌻Happy Birthday Harumasa! 🌻🌻🌻[/code][color=#D4D4D8]
A mod project I made to appreciate a beautifully written character Harumasa Asaba! I have been working on this for every weekend of months, for his birthday.[/color]

I will add more stuff as time goes and as I play the game more. Do tell if something is broken, I'll debug as fast as I could.

Note that is kinda spoiler:
[spoiler]I set a deadline for his existence in town. Once you hit year 4 and you haven't marry him, he will ran out of sick leaves and have to go back to New Eridu. For those who's already above year 4 but wanted to try marry him still, try the thing in installation instruction.[/spoiler]

  [b][u]🌻🌻🌻[/u][/b]    [b][u] 🌻🌻🌻[/u][/b]    [b][u] 🌻🌻🌻[/u][/b]    [b][u] 🌻🌻🌻 [/u][/b]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]

[color=#d4d4d8]Instal[/color][color=#d4d4d8]l, [/color][color=#d4d4d8]e[/color][color=#d4d4d8]xtract the files, and put it in the mods files[/color][color=#d4d4d8].[/color]

[spoiler][u]In case you want to uncap his existence:[/u]
- Find the mods folder then search: [NPC] Harumasa Asaba
- Click that file then find content.json, click that
- Find the following and delete it AND the coma right above it:
      "{{ModId}}_Goodbyes": {
        "Id": "{{ModId}}_Goodbye1",
        "Trigger": "DayStarted",
        "Condition": "YEAR 4, PLAYER_NPC_RELATIONSHIP Any AsabaHarumasa Friendly, !PLAYER_HAS_RUN_TRIGGER_ACTION all {{ModId}}_Goodbyes",
        "Actions": [
          "AddMail Current {{ModId}}_Goodbye now",
          "AddConversationTopic GoodbyeAsaba_memory_oneday",
          "SetNpcInvisible AsabaHarumasa 9999",
          "SetNPCInvisible Fraudmasa 9999",
          "SetNPCInvisible Soukaku 9999",
          "SetNPCInvisible Yanagi 9999",
          "SetNPCInvisible Hoshimi 9999"
        ]
      }[/spoiler]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8]- 6 Heart events, including a Bday event.
- A lot of dialogues
- Outfits for 4 seasons
- Movie Concessions (Probably a little broken since I haven't seen the movie stuff yet in game)[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]- HSO6 easter egg[/color]


[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI
Content Patcher[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout outs [/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]To everyone that created all the lovely tutorial and document all the game data in stardewmodding.wiki.gg![/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]It's impressive that I don't need to bother anyone to create this and just refer to the website. The completeness is mindboggling and I respect every single words typed in that site.[/color]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]It helps a lot as someone who have never coded before this! I'll never make it without you all! And of course, shoutout to Harumasa for keep on living life to the best, he's an inspiration to us all. Happy Birthday![/color][/size]
